title: Binary Search
statement:
Given a sorted array of distinct integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` if it is in `nums`. Otherwise return `-1`.
You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime.
hints: Keep two pointers at the ends of the range you still need to search.
Compare the middle value to the target and throw away half the range.
Stop when low passes high. That means the target is missing.
